title: Generic model options
description: Sampling options supported by OpenAI-compatible model servers.

controls.label: Temperature
controls.help: Controls randomness. Leave empty to use the server default.

controls.label: Top P
controls.help: Nucleus sampling threshold. Leave empty to use the server default.

controls.label: Min P
controls.help: Minimum probability relative to the most likely token.

controls.label: Top K
controls.help: Limits sampling to the K most likely tokens.

controls.label: Repeat penalty
controls.help: Penalizes repeated tokens. Leave empty to use the server default.

controls.label: Presence penalty
controls.help: Penalizes tokens that already appeared in the generated text.
